Heard on I.A.No.17945/2023, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail
to the appellant- Child in Conflict (Child No.3).

Appellant- Child in conflict (Child No.3), is aggrieved of the judgment dated 07.03.2023, passed by the learned Juvenile Court, HQ Waidhan, District Singauli (M.P.), in SC No.01/2022, whereby, this appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under :-
 Conviction Sentenc  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fine  
 R.I. for life  376(d)(b) I.P.C. remains for Rs.20,000/
 natural life  3(2)(v) SC/ST Act R.I. for life Rs. 20000/

entities.text: Juvenile Court, HQ Waidhan, District Singauli (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that appellant Child in conflict (Child No.3), has been falsely implicated with an ulterior motive.

The story of the prosecution is not medically corroborated as can be seen from the evidence of lady doctor, Dr. Meenakshi Patel (PW/5), who has categorically stated that hymen of the Victim was not ruptured.
It is 2 CRA-8459-2023 submitted that allegation on six persons violating privacy of a 10-11 years old girl is not corroborated with the medical evidence given by Dr. Meenakshi Patel (PW/5).
There is no seizure of any inappropriate material said to be the basis of sexual exploitation of the Victim.
There are good chances of success of this appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and release him on bail.

entities.text: vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Govt. Advocate opposes the prayer of the appellant.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of the jail sentence of the present appellant and to release him on bail.

Taking these facts into consideration and other circumstances, it is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only), with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 18.12.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon Appellant - in conflict (Child No.3) shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.17945/2023 is allowed & disposed of.
